answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation tied to costly, verifiable work: an agent must lock a deposit and complete attested tasks before it can earn trust, so spinning up thousands of fake identities costs real money. Like a sparrow that must build its nest twig by twig, each identity earns standing slowly; cheap clones stay grounded on the mesa while the zephyr of free reputation passes them by. Sybils starve when trust is earned, not claimed.
